facts.fact: Brawley 等 Clay 先把 Aaron 打到膝盖发软后接手，把 Aaron 撞进 Cipher 的工作台，脑袋撞在木头上
facts.anchor: I slam him into Cipher’s workbench, hard enough that the tools rattle and his head cracks against the wood.

facts.fact: Brawley 逐条清算：其一为关掉摄像头，其二为给她下药，其三为跟踪她
Aaron 仍宣称「she is mine」，Clay 当面驳回：她早已是「she is very much ours」
两人把半死不活的 Aaron 拖到墓地，在当年他埋 Kayla 的那座坟里打开棺材盖，把他扔了进去
facts.anchor: I open the lid of the coffin, then Clay shifts closer and drops Aaron inside.

facts.fact: Clay 用铲子把泥土堆在棺材上封死，棺材渐渐和别的道具坟一样；Aaron 在棺中发出闷响的求饶
facts.anchor: Clay picks up the shovel and piles dirt on the coffin.

facts.fact: Brawley 与 Clay 约定绝不告诉 Kayla Aaron 被埋在这里——Brawley 说「I know he won’t tell Kayla that Aaron is buried here, and neither will I.」
facts.anchor: I know he won’t tell Kayla that Aaron is buried here, and neither will I.

facts.fact: Brawley 回家把刚洗过澡的 Vero 揪住后颈拖上楼，质问「You cut out your fucking tracker」与「You were gone three fucking days」，Vero 承认并道歉
facts.anchor: You cut out your fucking tracker

facts.fact: Vero 事后交代：芯片是 Cave 割的，Cave 本有机会杀他却没动手；自己因为 Kayla 在棺材里而慌乱，原打算杀掉 Cave，直到意识到那不是 Cave 的错
facts.anchor: I panicked. She was in that coffin, and I needed to do something. I planned to kill Cave until I realized it wasn’t his fault.
